name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task is 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.' The hard Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) requires a switch toggle at or after each ring, and since siren_ringing is a lasting condition, the duty stays owed until the switch is toggled — exactly the task. No Existence is needed: siren_ringing is a condition of a 'whenever' clause, not a commanded goal, and switch_toggled is only the consequent. The rule-only warning is valid, and 'turn it off' matches switch_toggled as grounded.

texts: Each time the siren is ringing, toggle the siren switch to turn it off.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
